hero_badge: Your Direct Gateway to Studying in Turkey
hero_title: Start Your Academic Journey at Karabük University with Confidence
hero_subtitle: NABU Agency handles all procedures for international students: document preparation and translation, securing academic admission, student housing booking, flight tickets, and airport reception.
services_desc: We accompany you from your home country until you settle into your seat at Karabük
service1_desc: We translate and notarize all documents and certificates, ensuring error-free submission to the university.
service2_desc: We provide comfortable housing options near the campus that fit your budget and preference.
service3_desc: We book flight tickets at the best prices, meet you upon arrival in Turkey, and transport you to your residence.
service4_desc: Our team is with you step-by-step for student residency permits, transportation cards, and bank account setup.
carousel_desc: An overview of life and facilities inside the university campus
uni_info_subtitle: Facts and figures that make it a top choice for international students
stat1_desc: Ranked among the top 35 universities in Turkey for 2026 with full European and international recognition.
stat2_desc: A multicultural community representing over 90 countries, offering a welcoming student environment.
stat3_desc: Excellent opportunities to study a semester or full academic year in European partner universities.
stat4_desc: Housing and living costs in Karabük are significantly lower compared to Istanbul and Ankara.
process_page_desc: How to turn your dream of studying in Turkey into reality step-by-step
step1_desc: Select your preferred program and send copies of your documents via WhatsApp for initial review.
step2_desc: Our team translates your certificates into Turkish and notarizes them with the official notary (Noter).
step3_desc: We submit your file directly to Karabük University's portal and follow up until your acceptance letter is issued.
step4_desc: We prepare your housing options, assist with visa procedures, and book your flight tickets.
step5_desc: We greet you upon arrival in Turkey, transfer you to your accommodation, and finalize your university enrollment.
majors_page_desc: Browse academic programs at Karabük University and apply directly via WhatsApp
search_placeholder: Search for a major (e.g., Computer Engineering, Medicine, Business Administration)...
guide_page_title: Guide to Living in Karabük City
guide_page_desc: Everything students and parents need to know about the city, housing, and living conditions
guide_sec1_desc: A quiet and safe city located in northern Turkey, famous for its picturesque nature and proximity to historic Safranbolu.
guide_sec2_desc: Public, private, and shared student housing options are available at very affordable prices compared to major cities.
guide_sec3_desc: The city features various international and local restaurants, exchange offices, and direct transport services to campus.
guide_transport_desc: The city has an excellent transportation network connecting all neighborhoods to the university campus. Students enjoy large discounts using the Student Card.
